relevance_note: Two LAD1 patients with an ITGB2/CD18 variant are described individually: "a novel homozygous C562T nonsense mutation in exon 6 of the gene" in "two unrelated Palestinian children".
method_note: Hand extraction; a short Python script only assembled the JSON from values read by hand, and every span was checked verbatim by script. Table 1 has patients as columns (headers 'Patient #1', 'Patient #2'); column spans quote from the row label through the patient's cell. Age at presentation (3 and 12 months, Table 1 and Results) was not recorded as age at onset, because the paper gives it as age at presentation and delayed umbilical cord separation occurred earlier; age at umbilical cord separation (2.5 and 3) has no printed unit. Inheritance: the patients are homozygous and the paper states that the asymptomatic parents of both families are heterozygous (and that both mothers are carriers); the enum has no 'both parents' value, so 'inherited unspecified parent' was used. Relatives: Figure 1 legend lists 'their parents, one sister of patient #2 and one brother of patient #2', while the Results say 'parents and siblings of both families' are heterozygous; no sibling of Patient #1 is individually described, so no row was made for one (possible contradiction). The second parent of each patient is labelled 'parent of ...' because its sex is not stated, although the mother is named separately. Infantile fatalities due to recurrent infections in both families are mentioned only collectively (no individual detail), so no rows. 'ref [30] patient' is a previously reported normal heterozygote carrier of this mutation; note the paper also calls the mutation 'novel'. Contradiction: the Discussion says 'Before treatment, the reported mutation resulted in undetectable CD18 protein levels in both patients' cells' and the abstract reports 'complete absence of CD18 protein', but Table 2 and the Results give Patient #1 CD18 on 54% of lymphocytes, 35% of monocytes and 78% of granulocytes one week after stopping gentamicin. Net chemotaxis values '(4 and 19 cells/field)' and mothers' values '(41 and 75 cells/field)' were not assigned to individuals by position. Necrotic lesions (cervical; wrist, thigh) were recorded as features but the checklist item 'necrotic skin ulcers or pyoderma gangrenosum-like lesions' was left not reported because the paper does not say the lesions were skin ulcers. 'Deep and superficial abscesses' under 'Type of infection' were taken as skin or soft tissue infections. Relatives described as 'asymptomatic'/'healthy' got no feature rows; their checklist items are not reported. cdna_hgvs_as_stated holds the legacy string 'C562T' (no 'c.' prefix printed). Gene printed as CD18 (also ITGB2/CD18, ITB2).
